source.title: Irish News, 6 June 1964, p. 3 ("Rural council elections: eleven sitting members returned for Newry Rural Council")
source.publisher: Irish News (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Unopposed returns from the Lisburn Herald (23 May 1964, p. 3); contested counts from the Ulster Star (6 June 1964, p. 1) and the Belfast News-Letter (6 June 1964, p. 3).

note: Triennial election of Lisburn Rural District Council, polled Thursday 4 June 1964. The contested divisions reported are Suffolk and Upper Malone, and a ratepayers' candidate, Mr. Reginald Gregory Quinn, was returned for Ballygammon. The returning officer's notice of result (Irish News, 10 June 1964, p. 2) lists the members returned for all thirty-two divisions but its columns are broken in the scanned text, so the full return is not recorded here. Printed: 'Upper Malone - Joseph Robinson (I.), 720 votes. Not elected - William George Creighton (I.), 133.'
